mentions.name: HeyCheero
mentions.description: HeyCheero is an AI work journaling chat that helps users capture the right level of detail and build recaps, making it easy to look back before 1-on-1s and performance reviews. The app features a squirrel mascot named Cheero who serves as the companion's personality.
mentions.problem: The author always has an empty mind and half-understandable notes before 1-on-1s and performance reviews, and needs help building recaps that are easy to look back on.
mentions.audience: Work journaling for employees preparing for 1-on-1s and performance reviews
mentions.source_excerpt:
I always have empty mind and half understable notes before 1-on-1s and performance review so I build a work journal that helps me get right level of details and build recaps so it's easy to look back.

It's AI work journaling chat. It's called HeyCheero! Cheero is a squirrel, mascot/personality of the companion in the app.
